messages:
sanjay: FYI canary on dedicated-uk pool hit 2 OOMs during rollout after slot-rebalancer merge (PR #4823). memory surge around 45-46GB.

maya: ugh, when did that land? link to flamegraphs? :eyes:

sanjay: paste logs:```
OOM: alloc failed at kv::reserve(...) slab=hot mem_total=48GB mem_used=46.1GB seq_len=320
heaplet_count=172 active_slots=2400 -> after rebalance 4800
backtrace: runtime/kv::alloc -> kv::reserve -> kernel_route::select
```

devin: did kernel-router fallback change also go in this release? iirc there was a kernel-selection tweak (commit abc123) that alters per-request kernel choice. could be interacting.

sanjay: yep both landed together: rebalancer (def456) + kernel-router (abc123). my working theory: rebalance briefly doubled slot ownership, allocator split hot slab pages for moderate seqlen (200-400) -> fragmentation + transient double allocation.

lisa: reprod note: CI job `kv-mem-sensitivity` is failing on main as well, started trending up after merge.

ci-bot: Job kv-mem-sensitivity (build 1289) FAILED: peak_mem=46.2GB > threshold=45GB — https://ci.internal/r/1289

maya: can we repro locally with a synthetic mix? seqlen dist: 80% <128, 15% 256-512, 5% >1024 seems to hit it in canary.

devin: starting a local repro on gcp-small. running repro harness with --seq-hist=80,15,5 and rebalance heartbeat=30s. attaching pprof soon. initial run shows slab churn spikes aligned with rebalance heartbeat.

sanjay: bisect plan: revert rebalancer commit (def456) first and run canary. if OOMs stop -> rebalancer root cause. if still happening, revert kernel-router (abc123).

lisa: queued revert PR for rebalancer (revert-def456). tagging @oncall and eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy queued: revert-def456 -> canary-23. ETA ~10m.

maya: short-term mitigation options: bump eviction aggressiveness or pause rebalance heartbeat. toggles would be lower risk than full revert.

devin: rebalancer has `kv.rebalance.heartbeat_ms`. change from 30000 -> 300000 (30s -> 5m) should reduce oscillation; also could cap per-host slot delta to avoid sudden doubling.

sanjay: good call. i'll watch canary metrics (mem, slab churn, active_slots) and post flamegraphs. thanks. :thumbsup:

lisa: canary revert deployed. two canary replicas stable, no OOMs observed for 1h. CI job re-run looks green.

ci-bot: kv-mem-sensitivity passed on canary after revert (build 1293) — peak_mem=44.6GB.

sanjay: filing follow-ups: - postmortem with timeline + root cause hypothesis - add guardrail: auto-disable rebalance when slab-churn > X% - telemetry: emit slot-count delta per host - add unit/integration test for seqlen distributions that exercise mid-range sizes.

lisa: noted, will open issues and a retro. thanks all for fast triage.
